title: Recognising quality
explanation: Experience can help a person recognise quality that others miss. This is a craft metaphor, not an inherited ability or a claim about every member of a community.
meaning_odia: ସୁନା ପରଖିବାର ଅଭିଜ୍ଞତା ଥିଲେ ତାହାର ଗୁଣ ଚିହ୍ନିହୁଏ। ସେହି ଶିଳ୍ପକାମର ଚିତ୍ରକୁ ଅନ୍ୟର ଗୁଣ ଚିହ୍ନିବା ଓ ଆଦର କରିବା ସହ ମେଳାଯାଇଛି। ଏଠାରେ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ଓ ବୁଝାମଣାର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ଅଛି, କୌଣସି ସମୁଦାୟର ଜନ୍ମଗତ କ୍ଷମତାର ଦାବି ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: An experienced musician notices the care in a beginner’s performance. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
